description: Exhibit labels, collection records, and internal catalogs have started to drift, and inconsistent titles, dates, or attributions are appearing in public-facing interpretation.

user_profile.persona: 39-year-old curator balancing scholarship with public communication
user_profile.context: Small inconsistencies that once felt cosmetic now risk undermining trust in the exhibition materials
user_profile.communication_style: Clarity-focused and editorial, wants one authoritative wording for repeated facts

fact_sheet.fact: The official name of the data consistency initiative is 'Project Veracity'.
The deadline for reconciling the 'Modernist Sculpture' collection data is November 15, 2024.
Project Veracity's weekly status meeting is held every Tuesday at 10:00 AM PST via Webex.
The designated project tracking tool for Project Veracity is Asana, under the 'AAM - Curatorial' workspace.
The authoritative source for all collection data is the 'Argos Collections v3.2' system.
The login URL for the Argos Collections production environment is https://aam.argos.cloud/login.
The public-facing website runs on a CMS named 'WeavePress', which pulls data from the Argos API.
High-resolution images are managed in the 'MediaSphere 5.0' Digital Asset Management (DAM) system.
Dr. Elena Vance, Curator of European Painting, is the lead for Project Veracity.
David Chen is the Museum Registrar and is responsible for updating accession records in Argos.
Maria Flores, Head of Digital Initiatives, must approve all changes before they are pushed to the public website.
For technical support with Argos, contact the IT helpdesk by emailing helpdesk@atheriaart.org or calling extension 4357.
All dates must be formatted as YYYY-MM-DD; for date ranges, use YYYY/YYYY; for circa, use 'c. YYYY'.
The approved style guide for artist attributions and object descriptions is The Chicago Manual of Style, 17th Edition.
The master spreadsheet for tracking data conflicts is located at '\\aam-files\collections\Project_Veracity\Data_Conflict_Tracker_v2.xlsx'.
When a record is finalized in Argos, the 'Verification Status' field must be changed from 'Pending' to 'Curator-Approved'.
The canonical title for accession number AAM.1954.12.2 is 'Nocturne in Silver and Blue'.
The authoritative creation date for 'Nocturne in Silver and Blue' (AAM.1954.12.2) is 'c. 1888'.
The artist for AAM.1954.12.2 is Julian Croft (1852-1919).
The official medium for AAM.1954.12.2 is 'Oil on canvas'.
The accession number for Anya Petrova's sculpture is AAM.2003.4.1.
The authoritative title for AAM.2003.4.1 is 'The Gilded Cage', not 'Gilded Birdcage'.
The dimensions for 'The Gilded Cage' (AAM.2003.4.1) must be recorded in centimeters as '120.5 x 45.2 x 45.2 cm'.
The acquisition date for Samuel Ives's photograph 'Market Day at Port Lyra' (AAM.1978.22.5) is 1978-06-12.
All data correction approvals must be documented via email with the subject line 'VERACITY: Approval for [Accession Number]'.
The dedicated Slack channel for day-to-day project discussion is #proj-veracity.
A monthly progress report for Project Veracity is sent to museum leadership on the first business day of each month by Elena Vance.
The API endpoint for fetching verified object data for the website is https://api.atheriaart.org/v2/objects/verified.
Artist nationality must be selected from the Getty Union List of Artist Names (ULAN) controlled vocabulary.
